ARIZONA
Gila County

County SeatGlobe
Land Area4,758 sq mi

Median Household Income$62,000
Median Home Value$269,400
Gila County covers 4,758 square miles in central Arizona with about 53,800 residents split between the Payson area in the north and the Globe-Miami district in the south. Globe-Miami retains an active copper mining base with its associated historic housing stock, while Payson — at higher elevation roughly 90 minutes from metro Phoenix — functions substantially as a weekend and seasonal second-home market. Tonto National Forest and San Carlos Apache reservation land cover most of the county and constrain private inventory to established communities. Median home value is $269,400 against median household income of $62,000.
Source: U.S. Census Bureau · Data verified: August 21, 2026
